evidenceType: static packaged JavaScript; not runtime coverage

dynamicCases.observation: prefix, content, progressMessage and customTitle are rendered in separate spans; prefix often a static UI verb while content is a path, command, resource title, search text or backend/model summary. Some prefixes are themselves backend titlePrefix.
dynamicCases.recommendation: Only translate exact known static display prefixes after identifying the prefix span; protect data-uri/data-quotable-inline file pills. Do not translate the whole tool row or customTitle/toolSummary/progressMessage blindly.

dynamicTemplates.recommendation: Preserve backend c; only translate Error while in a component-scoped adapter.
Translate the static prefix; preserve b verbatim.
Numeric count template to N 个问题, confined to ask-question step title.

dynamicCases.observation: When textTransitionsEnabled is on, a string is split into unchanged segments and animated slots; data-slot-in contains m.to text, data-slot-out=m.from is displayed by CSS after:content-[attr(data-slot-out)].
dynamicCases.recommendation: The ordinary text-node observer cannot fully handle split phrases or CSS attr content. Treat this as an unresolved rendering path unless source-level display localization or a component-specific grouped adapter is added. Never concatenate/rewrite a parent containing mixed dynamic backend content. Keep animation outgoing/incoming values synchronized and reversible.
dynamicCases.scope: Only known static tool-title prefix spans; do not globally translate every data-slot-out attribute.

dynamicCases.observation: User text y=S3a(r.items) appears in span.line-clamp-2; fallback spans have text-muted-foreground and contain 1 comment, `${w} comments`, Empty message. Existing pending-user-messages exclusion does not cover this card.
dynamicCases.recommendation: Translate header/status/buttons and numeric fallback comments only; protect user message and user-derived messageLabel in edit/delete menu labels. Never make the entire role=region translatable.

dynamicTemplates.guard: The actual button under pending-user-messages; do not relax protection for user message descendants.

dynamicCases.observation: Permission app header M.displayName||M.name, actionDescription, reason and target are provider/model/user content. Shell target is rendered in pre and textarea. Fixed choices, action type labels and explanation text are UI.
dynamicCases.protectedScope: [data-testid='permission-app-header']; pre; [data-testid='permission-target-editor'] value; dynamic actionDescription and reason descendants
dynamicCases.recommendation: Translate fixed confirmation controls and static explanation. Translate aria-label='Edit permission target' while preserving editor value. Never translate the permission target, shell command, URL, path, or reason by whole container matching.

dynamicTemplates.guard: Known action enum only; preserve target exactly; toast scope only.
Translate static prefix only and preserve target; do not match arbitrary content globally.

dynamicCases.observation: Existing-project confirmation uses separate literal Project, dynamic project name, already exists for this, combination of folders, and trailing question. Workspace delete similarly separates dynamic workspace name from confirmation.
dynamicCases.recommendation: Use per-text-node component scoped fragments; preserve project/workspace names and selected folder paths. Project-selector-item carries data-project-name and its direct truncate span is user-owned; translate only its separate Project Settings action.

englishFragments: . Would you like to continue using it or make a new one?
chineseFragments: 。要继续使用它，还是创建新项目？
dynamicTemplates.guard: Existing-project confirmation component only; preserve intervening project name.

englishFragments: Are you sure you want to delete the workspace
dynamicTemplates.guard: Delete-workspace confirmation only; preserve intervening workspace name.
Reuse-project banner only; project count and folder parameters remain unchanged.
Only project/workspace selector empty states; do not add global generic fragments to dictionary.

dynamicCases.observation: The trigger contains model label t and optional effort v; menu RXb renders backend/custom model a.label. Either may equal a short UI key (Custom, High, Extra, etc.).
dynamicCases.recommendation: Preserve trigger model-name text and model menu names, including custom names. Effort translation requires separately identified effort node. Translate fixed Edit Model/Select Model controls and tooltip copy.

dynamicTemplates.guard: aria-label on model-selector-trigger only; preserve model t verbatim and map effort from finite known enum.

dynamicCases.observation: File basename, resource displayName, pageTitle/URL host, conversation title and sectionName are nested in button/span .inline-pill with data-uri and data-quotable-inline. They can match dictionary keys exactly.
dynamicCases.recommendation: Protect entire pill text/title, including descendants. Internal fallback labels Task Log, Overview, Sections may remain untranslated under conservative protection; translating those requires a semantic source marker. Do not infer that clickable text is UI copy.

dynamicCases.observation: Browser action button contains a.pageTitle||a.url, URL and a formatted time. Nearby QL menu actions Mention Page/Capture screenshot/Capture console logs are fixed UI.
dynamicCases.recommendation: Preserve the button's page-title/url spans; translate only fixed dropdown actions. DOM marker is not explicit, so a generic button whitelist cannot distinguish a page named Review/Project/Home from application copy.

dynamicCases.observation: CL FileTitle uses data-file-uri on the clickable parent, file-title-name for user basename/title, and SLa sibling for filesystem path. UI badge and action buttons share that parent.
dynamicCases.protectedScope: [data-testid='file-title-name']; [data-file-uri] > div[style] path display; notebook code/output, pre, code, .xterm, .monaco-editor
dynamicCases.recommendation: Protect name/path spans without excluding genuine action-button labels in the same header. Notebook cell output has data-independent content and must remain user-owned, including image alt generated from output.

dynamicCases.observation: Agent HTML and artifact comments are generated/user content; fallback contains user src basename c and static Preview disabled/Open Source Code. Controls and comments can be in the same outer card.
dynamicCases.recommendation: Protect generated HTML, filename span and comments; translate only control labels. Existing protectedSelector blocks entire markdown/prose ancestors, so comment/control buttons within those remain skipped unless carefully whitelisted as known UI controls. Do not globally remove markdown/prose protection.

ambiguousShortKeys.recommendation: The dictionary entries below are genuine UI labels, but must not be applied to arbitrary buttons/menu options/headers without user-content protections. If protection cannot be established, exclude from generic matching and allow only known UI scopes.
ambiguousShortKeys.brandBearingLabels: Compound fixed UI labels such as Open in Sponge, Fig share, CitC Clone, GoB Repository retain the product name and translate only the surrounding function noun/verb. They are not model-name rewrite rules.

safeUiScopes.purpose: Fixed terminal security note and aria-label.
Known quota-refresh status only; quota bucket/model displayName siblings remain dynamic.
Fixed Show details button only; actionDescription/reason are dynamic.
Known first-party feedback questionnaire labels/options. Do not use all ask-question panels as fixed UI; agent questions/options are model content.
Fixed Open Source Code action; adjacent source filename remains protected.

suggestedRegressionCases: Project/workspace/conversation titles exactly matching Models, Review, Project, Default, Home, Folder, Artifact or New retain originals through Chinese->English->Chinese.
A file named Review or Folder without extension, browser page title Review, resource displayName New, custom model label High are never translated.
Queued user message exactly Open, Review, Continue or Models remains unchanged while Queued Messages and empty/comment fallback translate.
Permission command/target/reason/actionDescription and plugin displayName remain unchanged; fixed permission controls translate.
Tool title known prefix translates; command/file pill/backend summary remains unchanged; CSS animated outgoing/incoming text does not mix languages.
Notebook plain-text output equal to a dictionary key remains unchanged; fixed notebook preview/error UI translates.
Agent ask-question prompt/options stay model content while first-party battle-winner-survey questionnaire translates.
Removed/recreated nodes, changed tool state and language switching restore app original values without overwriting updates.
remainingBoundary: 931 exact static dictionary candidates were checked against selected app UI regions; this does not establish runtime coverage for gated/internal features, dynamic server error text, generated UI, nested remote documents or animations. Candidate numbers must not be presented as a percentage of complete localization.
